name: web-terminal
description: Full-featured browser-based terminal with multi-pane workspaces, SSH bastion access, AI chat assistant, and AEE audit trail. Manage your entire infrastructure without leaving QuoxCORE.
shortDescription: Browser-based terminal with multi-pane workspaces and AI assistant.
author: QUOX

defaultShell.label: Default Shell
defaultShell.description: Shell to launch when opening a new terminal session.

scrollbackLines.label: Scrollback Lines
scrollbackLines.description: Number of lines to keep in scrollback buffer.

marketingPoints: Full terminal in your browser — no SSH client needed
Multi-pane workspaces — up to 4 terminals side by side
SSH to any host via bastion — password and key auth
AI chat assistant — ask questions alongside your terminal
Workspace tabs — organize sessions by project or task
Complete AEE audit trail for all terminal activity

webShell.name: Web Shell
webShell.description: Full interactive shell in the browser with xterm.js rendering, 256-color support, clickable links, and auto-fit to viewport.

multiPane.name: Multi-Pane Layouts
multiPane.description: Split your terminal into 2 or 4 panes with 8 layout presets. Each pane runs an independent session.

sshBastion.name: SSH via Bastion
sshBastion.description: SSH into any registered host through the bastion gateway. Supports password and key-based authentication.

aiChat.name: AI Chat Assistant
aiChat.description: Overlay chat panel powered by ChatEngine with full AEE audit trail, memory context, and Smart Router bypass.

workspaceTabs.name: Workspace Tabs
workspaceTabs.description: Organize terminal sessions into named workspace tabs. Each workspace has its own layout and pane configuration.

sessionPersistence.name: Session Persistence
sessionPersistence.description: Terminal sessions survive page refreshes and network interruptions. Reconnect and pick up where you left off.

auditTrail.name: Audit Trail
auditTrail.description: Every terminal session is logged to the AEE audit system with open/close timestamps and AOCL layer tracking.

terminalCommands.name: Terminal Command Execution
terminalCommands.description: Let QUOX agents read terminal output and suggest or execute commands programmatically.

requirements.external: Collector service with node-pty and ssh2 support
